# Test files

Generated by `tools/make_testdata.py`: uncompressed OpenEXR files (`<case>.exr`) with the expected 8-bit image
(`<case>.png`), computed without the OpenEXR library. `depth_only.exr` has no colour and must be declined.

```
python tools/make_testdata.py testdata                         # rewrite them
exr2png testdata/<case>.exr testdata/<case>.out.png            # decode each file
python tools/make_testdata.py testdata --check                 # compare
```

The official test images are not included: clone
https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openexr-images into `testdata/openexr-images` (see docs/FORMAT.md).
